I am an existing Hotlink Prepaid user with a credit balance, looking to upgrade to Hotlink Postpaid. Can I retain my number, and what will happen to my prepaid credit?

Yes, you can upgrade from Hotlink Prepaid to Hotlink Postpaid and keep your existing number. Any unused prepaid credit will be transferred to your postpaid phone plan account and reflected in your first bill. 

You can upgrade at any Hotlink or Maxis store, or online via the Hotlink Online Store.

What is the difference between Maxis and Hotlink Postpaid?

Both run on the same high-quality network. Hotlink Postpaid serves as a budget-friendly option for individuals, while Maxis Postpaid offers premium and family-focused postpaid plans, with added benefits and shared data lines.

Which is the most budget-friendly postpaid plan?

The Hotlink Postpaid 50 is the most affordable option among the 5G postpaid plans, ideal for everyday users.

Best for:
Everyday users with moderate internet & call usage, as well as streaming needs.

  • Tailor-made for those who want sufficient high-speed 5G internet to power their daily apps, as well as unlimited voice calls and SMS.
     

Plan Details:

  • Monthly charge: RM50
  • Internet quota: 500GB (4G/5G)
  • Unlimited calls and SMS
  • No contract required


Factors to consider before choosing a plan:

  • Internet quota and 5G postpaid speed
  • Hotspot allowance
  • Smartphone bundle eligibility
  • Contract commitment

What are the cheapest postpaid plans in Malaysia under RM100?

Hotlink offers some of the most affordable postpaid plans in Malaysia under RM100, starting from just RM50 per month. The Hotlink Postpaid 50 plan includes 500GB of 4G/5G data along with unlimited calls and SMS, making it ideal for everyday users with moderate usage.

For those needing more internet quota, Hotlink Postpaid 75 (600GB) provide excellent value while still staying below RM100. All plans come with unlimited high-speed internet access and full 4G/5G network compatibility, making them among the best-value options in the Malaysian market.

Which postpaid plans in Malaysia come with phone bundle options?

Hotlink offers selected postpaid plan with smartphone bundle options, ideal for users looking to pair their mobile plan with a new device. The Hotlink Postpaid 75 plan offers attractive deals, including free 5G phone options with selected bundles. 

This bundle plan also comes with high internet quota (600GB), unlimited calls and SMS, and full 4G/5G connectivity—making it a great choice for heavy users who want both performance and device upgrades in one package.

What is a Hotlink Postpaid Device Contract?

The Hotlink Postpaid Normal Device Contract lets you get a wide range of phones below the recommended retail price and enjoy the flexibility of paying only for your mobile plan each month. No monthly device payments—just a simple upfront cost for the phone, and you're all set! Plus, enjoy exclusive postpaid perks with Hotlink Rewards, including app-only deals and vouchers.

How does a postpaid plan with a phone work?

Here’s how it works:

  • Service & Device Bundle: Get a wide range of phones below the recommended retail price.
  • Monthly Bill: You will be billed at the end of each cycle for your postpaid plan and device.
  • Payment Options: Pay online, via banking, or through auto-debit.
  • Commitment Period: Typically 12, 24, or 36 months.
  • Credit Check: Required for approval.

 

Example:

Item Amount
 Remark
Device Upfront Payment
 RM99 (one-time)
 Non-refundable
Device Advance Payment
 RM240 (one-time) RM10 monthly bill waiver (RM240 ÷ 24 months)
Plan Monthly Payment
 RM75 (24 months) RM75 plan – RM10 rebate

What do I need to pay to sign up for the Hotlink Postpaid Device Contract?

Under the Hotlink Postpaid Normal Device Contract, you are generally required to pay:
  1. Device Price (Device Upfront Payment): Starting from as low as RM0 (this price is lower than the recommended retail price).
  2. Device Advance Payment: A refundable deposit credited back over your contract term (12, 24, or 36 months).
  3. Refundable Deposit: For foreigners, a refundable deposit of RM150 may be applicable when signing up for a new line with a device, in addition to the device price and device advance payment.

What’s the difference between Device Upfront and Device Advance Payment?

The Device Upfront Payment is the one-time amount you pay to own your device outright under our Normal Device Contract. This payment:
  • Reduces the total device cost (vs. paying the full recommended retail price)
  • Is paired with your chosen Hotlink rate plan for ongoing service
  • Varies by device model and plan

How do I pay my postpaid phone plan bill?

The Device Advance Payment (DAP) is collected as a token of your commitment, and it will be fully refunded to you as monthly bill rebates over your contract period.

Example: A RM240 DAP on a 24-month plan = RM10 will be credited monthly to your bill.

What is the Hotlink Postpaid Online Store Offer?

Get RM10 off your monthly bill for 12 months when you sign up for Hotlink Postpaid 50 or Hotlink Postpaid 75 via the Hotlink Online Store. This offer applies to:

  • New line activations.
  • Upgrades from Hotlink Prepaid.
  • Port-ins from other telcos.

When is the offer period?

This offer is ongoing and available until 31st December 2026.

Who can enjoy this offer?

Applicable to:

  • Malaysians and non-Malaysians aged 18 and above.
  • New subscribers to Hotlink Postpaid 50 or Hotlink Postpaid 75, via the Hotlink Online Store.

How do I claim the Hotlink Postpaid Online Store Offer?

Simply register online for Hotlink Postpaid 50 or Hotlink Postpaid 75 via the Hotlink Online Store. The RM10 rebate will be automatically applied to your bill for the first 12 months. 

How do I upgrade my Hotlink Prepaid to Hotlink Postpaid via the Online Store?

Ensure your prepaid line is active and has no outstanding SOS top-ups.

  1. Visit the Hotlink Online Store.
  2. Select “Postpaid Plan” and click “Buy Now”.
  3. Choose “Get a New Line”.
  4. Complete TAC and Face ID verification.
  5. Select “Upgrade to Hotlink Postpaid” (if eligible).
  6. Submit your details and wait for a confirmation SMS (within 10 minutes).

What is a Hotlink Postpaid Device Contract?
The Hotlink Postpaid Normal Device Contract lets you get a wide range of phones below the recommended retail price and enjoy the flexibility of paying only for your mobile plan each month. No monthly device payments—just a simple upfront cost for the phone, and you're all set! Plus, enjoy
exclusive postpaid perks
with Hotlink Rewards, including app-only deals and vouchers.
How does a postpaid plan with a phone work?
Here’s how it works:

: Get a wide range of phones below the recommended retail price.
Monthly Bill
: You will be billed at the end of each cycle for your postpaid plan and device.
Payment Options
: Pay online, via banking, or through auto-debit.
Commitment Period
: Typically 12, 24, or 36 months.

What do I need to pay to sign up for the Hotlink Postpaid Device Contract?
Under the Hotlink Postpaid Normal Device Contract, you are generally required to pay:
Device Price (Device Upfront Payment):
Starting from as low as RM0 (this price is lower than the recommended retail price).
Device Advance Payment:
A refundable deposit credited back over your contract term (12, 24, or 36 months).
Refundable Deposit:
For foreigners, a refundable deposit of RM150 may be applicable when signing up for a new line with a device, in addition to the device price and device advance payment.
What’s the difference between Device Upfront and Device Advance Payment?
The Device Upfront Payment is the one-time amount you pay to own your device outright under our Normal Device Contract. This payment:
Reduces the total device cost (vs. paying the full recommended retail price)
Is paired with your chosen Hotlink rate plan for ongoing service
Varies by device model and plan
How do I pay my postpaid phone plan bill?
The Device Advance Payment (DAP) is collected as a token of your commitment, and it will be fully refunded to you as monthly bill rebates over your contract period.
Example: A RM240 DAP on a 24-month plan = RM10 will be credited monthly to your bill.
